feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Woman, 80, in critical condition after being set on fire
articles.summary: An 80-year-old woman set on fire outside her flat has been named by police.

articles.title: Mosque handed warning over 'inflammatory' sermons seeks legal advice
articles.summary: An Islamic centre that was given an official warning for hosting "inflammatory, divisive" sermons by the charities regulator is seeking legal advice.

articles.title: Team reviewing alleged war crimes did not see key evidence, Afghanistan inquiry told
articles.summary: Key information on photographic evidence was left out when an independent review team was asked to examine whether UK special forces had committed war crimes, an inquiry has heard.

articles.title: No 'certainty' man abused woman advertised for sex by husband, court told
articles.summary: A lack of evidence means it is not possible to prove that a defendant is guilty of abusing a woman advertised for sex by her husband, his lawyer has told a court.

articles.title: British soldier charged with rape of woman in Cyprus
articles.summary: A British soldier has been charged with the rape of a woman serving with UK forces in Cyprus.

articles.title: Poundland bosses meet to decide firm's future
articles.summary: The directors of Poundland are holding a board meeting tonight to decide the company's future, Sky News has been told.

articles.title: Woman who stole £2k worth of drinks from one Greggs store avoids prison
articles.summary: A prolific shoplifter who stole more than £2,000 worth of soft drinks from one Greggs store has avoided prison.

articles.title: Body mass index may have misclassified millions of people in UK, researchers say
articles.summary: Millions of people may have been misclassified on the body mass index (BMI) scale, research has suggested.

articles.title: Police address 'violent incident' claim against Russell Brand made by Jemima Goldsmith
articles.summary: Police have addressed an alleged "violent incident" involving Russell Brand after claims made by his ex-girlfriend Jemima Goldsmith.

articles.title: US accuses three men of 'campaign of terror' against Jewish targets and plot against RAF Fairford
articles.summary: The US has accused three men linked to Iran of masterminding a "campaign of terror" against Jewish targets in the UK and Europe, as well as a thwarted plot at RAF Fairford.
